title: CASETiFY Drops ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Collab With ‘Tiger’ Tail Bag Charms & Concert-Inspired Phone Cases
summary: The limited-edition collection "brings the KPop Demon Hunters universe to life in a playful and functional way."
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

HUNTR/X stormed the Hot 100 charts with their hit song “Golden” and now, the KPop Demon Hunters girl group is making a play for your phone with a new collaboration with accessories brand CASETiFY.

The CASETiFY x KPop Demon Hunters capsule is an all-new collection of devices cases, phone grips, keychains and bag charms inspired by the hit animated musical . “Fusing Rumi’s ancestral spiritual strength, Mira’s bold personality, and Zoey’s fluid rhythm with the collective power of the Honmoon Glow, CASETiFY has created a curated collection that brings the KPop Demon Hunters universe to life in a playful and functional way,” a press release reads.

Rumi's Team Bundle Set

$152 $166 8% off

Buy Now AT CASETIFY

CASETiFY is selling bundle sets like this one, which includes a Rumi-themed phone case, a silver and lavender earbuds case, a Rumi keychain (with charms) and a “lucky knot” bag charm that celebrates the lead singer of HUNTR/X.

You can select your phone brand and model, as well as the type of earbuds you have on the CASETiFY site to make sure the products are compatible with the devices you own. Each phone case also displays a message to fans. Rumi’s message: “This is the battle for hearts and minds. A battle for the fans.”

Mira's Team Bundle Set

Mira’s set includes the same four accessories with a pink colorway and detailing. Mira’s phone case displays the phrase, “When you mess with our fans, we need to make it hurt.”

The shiny earbuds case features a pink heart design and Mira’s signature. While CASETiFY makes products in all sorts of materials and colorways, the KPop Demon Hunters collection showcases the new “chrome” look, which features a “high-polish liquid silver” colorway and “gritty demon markings,” according to a press release.

Zoey's Team Bundle Set

Zoey’s set features the chrome collection with green accents. The lead rapper’s phone case displays the message, “Happy fans, happy honmoon.”

All of the phone cases in this collection are MagSafe-compatible, allowing you to charge your device wirelessly without needing to remove the case. The case is also impact-resistant in case of accidental dings and drops whether you’re fighting off demons or fending off crowds at the Idol Awards (or like, at other big music and sports events).

Derpy Fur Case & Charm Bundle Set

$82 $96 15% off

Aside from the HUNTR/X girls, you can also pick up this Derpy set, inspired by the film’s supernatural tiger.

This set features a phone case and bag charm made from fuzzy “tiger” fur, with Derpy’s blue and white stripes.

You can also buy each of the above products individually on the CASEtiFY site . The site also has phone cases inspired by the Saja Boys, Sussie and more subtle options that use prints and motifs inspired by the KPop Demon Hunters characters rather than featuring the faces of the characters themselves.

Honmoon Pattern Case

$64

This honmoon -inspired case, for example, features a colorful metallic interpretation of the film’s spirit door, which is said to be woven from lingering souls.

Inspired by HUNTR/X’s stylistic edge, this line “pulses with vibrant neon energy, empowering fans to style their favorite HUNTR/X member with the same expressive, layered aesthetic seen on the global stage,” reads a release.

HUNTR/X CD Gripstand in Blind Box

$38

And you can find HUNTR/X member phone grips as part of the CASETiFY collab.

Tapping into the blind box trend , CASETiFY is selling a mystery box that contains one gripstand per pack. You can open the box to reveal a Rumi, Mira or Zoey phone grip or the ultimate chase: an ultra-rare GOLDEN disc that features the signature of each HUNTR/X member.
